llm.reply:
Clinical investigations in non-small cell lung cancer actively evaluate tyrosine kinase inhibitors, cerebrospinal fluid dynamics, and cellular immunotherapies targeting epidermal growth factor receptor alterations [1][4][5]. Multiple sequence variants spanning NM_005228.5 characterize the mutational spectrum of this receptor [6][7]. The findings detail clinical trial names and specific sequence variants, but do not provide recruitment status for the listed studies [1][2][3].

## Clinical Trial Landscape
One protocol evaluates targeted agents under the clinical trial name A Retrospective Study of EGFR-TKIs,Gefitinib, Erlotinib and Osimertinib in NSCLC Patients Treatment [1]. Another effort assesses survival endpoints under the clinical trial name Survival Outcome of EGFR-TKI in Uncommon EGFR Mutant Advanced NSCLC [2]. Third-generation therapy is monitored under the clinical trial name Osimertinib for Advanced EGFR-positive NSCLC Patients [3]. Central nervous system involvement is addressed under the clinical trial name CSF Analysis in EGFR Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With Leptomeningeal Disease [4]. Novel adoptive cellular therapy is explored under the clinical trial name EGFR/B7H3 CAR-T on Lung Cancer and Triple Negative Breast Cancer [5].

## Receptor Sequence Variants
A missense alteration is documented as SequenceVariant ClinVar:1000076, name: NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.840C>A (p.Asn280Lys) [6]. An extracellular domain substitution is recorded as SequenceVariant ClinVar:1000203, name: NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.664C>T (p.Arg222Cys) [7]. An additional amino acid exchange is identified as SequenceVariant ClinVar:1000496, name: NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.494G>A (p.Arg165Gln) [8]. A proximate alteration is registered as SequenceVariant ClinVar:1000546, name: NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.652C>A (p.Gln218Lys) [9].

Clinical evaluations address tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapies, cerebrospinal fluid dynamics, and cellular immunotherapies across non-small cell lung cancer populations harboring distinct epidermal growth factor receptor alterations [1][2][3][4][5]. Multiple genomic sequence variants cataloged in ClinVar characterize distinct coding alterations across the EGFR transcript [6][7][8]. However, the provided findings list only study titles and variant identifiers, lacking recruitment status values or functional characterization data to identify actively recruiting trials [1][2][3][4][5].

## Clinical Studies

A Retrospective Study of EGFR-TKIs,Gefitinib, Erlotinib and Osimertinib in NSCLC Patients Treatment evaluates tyrosine kinase inhibitor outcomes in patients [1]. Another investigation is designated Survival Outcome of EGFR-TKI in Uncommon EGFR Mutant Advanced NSCLC [2]. Targeted intervention is also assessed in Osimertinib for Advanced EGFR-positive NSCLC Patients [3]. Central nervous system involvement is addressed in CSF Analysis in EGFR Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With Leptomeningeal Disease [4]. Cellular immunotherapy is evaluated in EGFR/B7H3 CAR-T on Lung Cancer and Triple Negative Breast Cancer [5].
